authority: T0 analytic theorem for a newly declared Wick-coherent extension of the EXP-000773 fixed-torus Q3 state: exact thermal-to-vacuum Wick dictionary, one beta-independent compact-circle vector P(phi)2 Hamiltonian, Feynman-Kac-Nelson Gibbs identification, unique finite-volume ground and strict scalar-gauge-invariant ground advantage over the free-vacuum trial; claim-nonbearing and not a theorem for arbitrary bounded K_beta, the original fixed-raw CL8 family, thermodynamic phase selection, physical empty space, C6, CP1, or Pre-A

external_authority.scalar_Hamiltonian: J. Glimm and A. Jaffe, Positivity and self-adjointness of the P(phi)2 Hamiltonian, Commun. Math. Phys. 22 (1971) 253-258, DOI 10.1007/BF01877508
external_authority.charged_nonradial_precedent: C. Gerard, Spectral and scattering theory of space-cutoff charged P(varphi)2 models, arXiv:0906.5478, especially Proposition 4.1, Theorem 4.3 and Corollary 4.5
external_authority.thermal_FKN_precedent: C. Gerard and C. D. Jaekel, arXiv:math-ph/0403048 and arXiv:math-ph/0609088
external_authority.boundary: The scalar and two-real-component nonradial P(phi)2 mechanisms are prior art. This package writes the finite eight-component Q3 adaptation and its exact Wick-coordinate interface; it does not claim novelty for constructive Hamiltonian or Feynman-Kac theory.

setup.space: fixed spatial circle S_L, L finite, with m0>0
setup.fixed_polynomial: P_*(q)=q^T K_* q/2+W4(q), with any fixed real symmetric K_*

thermal_vacuum_Wick_dictionary.finite_difference: D_(beta,L)=lim_N(C_(beta,N)-C_(star,N))=L^(-1)sum_k[omega_k(exp(beta omega_k)-1)]^(-1)>0 and tends to zero as beta tends to infinity
thermal_vacuum_Wick_dictionary.matrix_coherence: one fixed vacuum-Wick matrix exists if and only if K_beta=K_*+3D_beta A_Q3
thermal_vacuum_Wick_dictionary.absolute_scalar_coherence: if the thermal density also contains e_beta and the fixed Hamiltonian contains e_*, exact unnormalized equality requires e_beta=e_*+(D_beta/2)Tr K_*+6D_beta^2 G
thermal_vacuum_Wick_dictionary.necessity: comparison of the degree-two and degree-zero Wick coefficients makes the matrix and scalar conditions necessary as well as sufficient within the common diagonal-covariance Q3 basis
thermal_vacuum_Wick_dictionary.Q3_matrix_boundary: for lambda>0 both the identity and L_Q3 coefficients run; scalar mass-only tuning cannot represent the common Hamiltonian

Hamiltonian_construction.interaction: V_L=integral_(S_L) :P_*(phi(x)):_(C_star) dx in the eight-component Gaussian Q-space
Hamiltonian_construction.finite_component_adaptation: component-indexed Wick kernels are a finite sum; product-Gaussian hypercontractivity and N_tau estimates are unchanged up to finite constants, while W4>=g|q|^4/32 supplies stability
Hamiltonian_construction.result: the cutoff forms converge to a closed lower-bounded form whose self-adjoint generator is H_L=H0+V_L; the finite-mode Hamiltonians converge in strong resolvent sense
Hamiltonian_construction.comparison: for every epsilon>0 there is C_epsilon with H0<=(1+epsilon)H_L+C_epsilon after a harmless common lower-bound shift
Hamiltonian_construction.trace_and_compactness: Tr exp(-sH0)=product_(k in Z)(1-exp(-s omega_k))^(-8)<infinity; the form comparison and min-max give compact resolvent and Tr exp(-sH_L)<infinity for every s>0
Hamiltonian_construction.positivity: the free Mehler kernel is positivity improving and the Feynman-Kac weight is strictly positive, so exp(-sH_L) is positivity improving and the compact ground eigenvector is unique up to phase

Feynman_Kac_Nelson_identification.trace_formula: Tr exp(-beta H_L)/Tr exp(-beta H0)=E_(mu_beta,L) exp[-integral_(T_beta times S_L):P_*(Phi):_(C_star) dt dx]
Feynman_Kac_Nelson_identification.correlators: the same formula holds with ordered bounded sharp-time multiplication observables
Feynman_Kac_Nelson_identification.thermal_rewrite: using K_beta=K_*+3D_beta A_Q3 and the coherent scalar rewrites the normalized loop law exactly as the EXP-000773 whole-thermal-Wick Q3 law
Feynman_Kac_Nelson_identification.beta0_match: given the EXP-000773 terminal K_(beta0), K_*=K_(beta0)-3D_(beta0,L)A_Q3 uniquely embeds that state into the coherent all-beta family
Feynman_Kac_Nelson_identification.KMS: rho_(beta,L)=exp(-beta H_L)/Tr exp(-beta H_L) is a faithful normal beta-KMS state on B(F), and its periodic OS reconstruction agrees with EXP-000773 at beta0
Feynman_Kac_Nelson_identification.boundary: arbitrary merely bounded K_beta families do not define this common Hamiltonian; the coherence law is additional declared structure

strict_ground_reference.vacuum_expectation: q_L[Omega0]=0 in the fixed vacuum-Wick convention, where q_L is the closed Hamiltonian form
strict_ground_reference.four_particle_witness: Omega0 and the normalized four-zero-mode vector chi_e lie in Q(H_L), and q_L(chi_e,Omega0)=(g+3lambda)sqrt(4!)/(16 L m0^2)>0; the quadratic matrix has no four-particle contribution
strict_ground_reference.Rayleigh_Ritz: with B=q_L[chi_e] finite and psi_t=(Omega0-t chi_e)/sqrt(1+t^2), q_L[psi_t]=[-2tA+t^2B]/(1+t^2)<0 for sufficiently small t>0
strict_ground_reference.result: E0(H_L)<q_L[Omega0]=0; equivalently E0(H_L)-q_L[Omega0]<0, which is invariant under H_L->H_L+cI
strict_ground_reference.uniqueness: compactness and positivity improvement make the interacting ground unique; it is invariant under every symmetry shared by K_* and W4 (always global Z2, and full Q3 graph symmetry only when K_* also has it)
strict_ground_reference.beta_limit: F_H(beta)-F_0(beta) tends to E0(H_L)<0 as beta tends to infinity; D_beta and the coherent scalar tend to zero, so the coherent thermal-Wick representation has the same ground limit

physical_and_thermodynamic_boundary.reference: Omega0 is the named massive free Fock vacuum selected by inserted m0,L and K_* units, not a derived cosmic empty-space state
physical_and_thermodynamic_boundary.absolute_energy: the invariant theorem compares the interacting ground to its own free-vacuum trial expectation; it does not fix the gravitational or absolute vacuum-energy zero
physical_and_thermodynamic_boundary.thermodynamic: fixed-L strictness does not prove that L^(-1)[E0(H_L)-<Omega0,H_L Omega0>] has a strictly negative L->infinity limit
physical_and_thermodynamic_boundary.phase: the unique finite-volume symmetric ground is not spontaneous symmetry breaking, condensate selection or a genuine phase transition
physical_and_thermodynamic_boundary.microlocal: Hamiltonian/FKN construction does not by itself prove an interacting microlocal-spectrum or Hadamard condition

prior_art_boundary: Self-adjoint lower-bounded P(phi)2 Hamiltonians, Feynman-Kac-Nelson formulas, positivity improvement and thermal Gibbs constructions are established prior art. A charged two-real-component nonradial theorem demonstrates that radiality is not essential. The eight-component Q3 adaptation is a finite-index verification and repository interface theorem, not a world-first claim. No located source proves the complete TECT Pre-A physical chain.
no_overclaim: This theorem constructs one mathematically coherent beta-independent Hamiltonian only for the newly declared vacuum-Wick extension on a fixed spatial circle. It does not retrofit an arbitrary bounded K_beta family or the original fixed-raw CL8 quadratic. Its strict negative ground advantage is relative to the named free Fock vacuum trial and does not identify physical empty space or fix absolute gravitational vacuum energy. It proves no thermodynamic limit, spontaneous transition, condensate selection, interacting Hadamard/microlocal spectrum, original three-dimensional Q3 parent, physical light, C0, N1-N5, C6, CP1, Sector A, or Pre-A.
